thesis: Q1 2026 revenue exceeded $1B for first time (+32% YoY), AI-native customer expansion driving ARR growth, software ETFs outperforming QQQ as AI software trade strengthens. Goldman Sachs Sell rating (PT $139) is an outlier; consensus is Buy. Long-term AI infrastructure monitoring play with durable competitive advantage in observability.

Rezdiffra (resmetirom) is the first FDA-approved NASH therapy. Q1 2026 net sales $311M (+127% YoY) with 42,250+ active patients. Strong durable moat as first mover. Average analyst PT $671 (Strong Buy consensus with 13 analysts). Early-stage patient penetration vs total addressable market. Path to profitability as drug scales.

Berkshire Hathaway (Greg Abel) maintains core OXY position. Oil structurally elevated due to Iran/Strait of Hormuz closure and UAE OPEC exit. Q1 EPS $1.06 beat; production at 1.43M BOE/day above guidance; free cash flow +52% YoY; debt reduction ongoing. Average analyst PT $64.33. Truist Hold with PT $57 (below current) is risk to monitor.

Visa dominates global payment rails with a durable duopoly moat. FY Q2 2026 revenue +17% YoY (fastest since 2022), adjusted EPS $3.31 beat. Payment volumes +9%, 66.1B transactions processed, value-added services 30% of revenue. Berkshire holds. ValueAct increased stake May 2026. Average analyst PT $387-399 (Strong Buy, 38 analysts). Quarterly dividend $0.67/share.

Consumer staples defensive play and digital transformation story. Q1 FY2026: EPS $0.61 beat (vs $0.58 est, +5.7%), eCommerce +22%, advertising +50%, membership income +14.8%. Gas prices driving value-seeking consumers to Walmart. 28/30 analysts Buy, PT avg $140.35. Revenue miss ($163.98B vs $164.43B) minor; digital metrics are the long-term thesis driver.
